_note: Single source of truth for every Materialize price. The quote engine (api/_lib/print/quote.js) is pure and reads only this file; no price is ever computed in a frontend module or a handler. Owner-tunable: change a number here and every surface follows.

_sources.note: Full-colour sandstone published at $0.99 per cm3 plus a $1.50 per-model startup fee, 2 mm minimum wall.
Bureau bands used as the sanity check on every rate below: FDM $0.05-$0.15 per gram plus $3-$10 setup, SLA resin $0.20-$0.50 per gram plus $3-$10 setup, SLS and metal $1-$10 per cm3 through a bureau.
SLS PA12 quoted from about $0.60 per cm3, rising for filled nylons.
Metal powder-bed benchmarks span $10-$100 per cm3 depending on alloy and run size, which is why the metal entry is quote-on-request rather than instantly priced.

pricing._marginNote: Declared platform margin already inside every rate below, so a rate can be compared against a bureau's published price directly. Buyer-facing output never includes this field.

holderDiscount._note: $THREE holder tiers (api/_lib/three-tier.js) discount platform compute up to 30 percent. A physical print carries real fulfillment cost, so the same tier bps is capped at 15 percent here and never touches shipping, which is passed through.

pricing._quantityNote: A repeat of the same object reuses the same build setup and the same prepared file, so the break applies to setup, material and finish, not to shipping.

materials.name: Standard resin
materials.blurb: Crisp SLA detail with a smooth, slightly glossy surface. The default for figures, busts and anything where the sculpt is the point.

materials.name: Tough resin
materials.blurb: Impact-resistant SLA for parts that get handled, snapped together or dropped. Holds an edge without shattering.

materials.name: SLS nylon (PA12)
materials.blurb: Powder-bed nylon: no support scars, prints interlocking and unsupported geometry other processes refuse. Matte, slightly grainy, very tough.

materials.name: Full-colour sandstone
materials.blurb: Binder-jetted gypsum printed in full colour, straight from the model's own texture. The only material here that reproduces what you see in the viewer.

materials.name: PLA draft
materials.blurb: The cheapest way to hold the thing. Visible layer lines, generous tolerances, fastest turnaround: print it, look at it, then order the real one.

materials.name: 316L stainless steel
materials.blurb: Powder-bed stainless, machined off the plate and bead blasted. Priced by an engineer against the actual geometry, not by the calculator.

shipping._volumetricNote: Air-freight convention: chargeable kg is the greater of real mass and (length x width x height in cm) / 5000. A hollow resin figure ships on its box, not its grams.
